entities.title: Taps and held keys are told apart by timing
entities.summary: Presses of the same arrow within 250 ms count as a double or triple tap; presses closer than 60 ms are taken as a held key's auto-repeat and move one step each, unless the terminal reports repeats through the kitty keyboard protocol.
entities.impact: Without the kitty protocol, a key repeat slower than 60 ms can be read as taps and jump by a word, page or to an edge, and very fast deliberate taps are read as a held key.
entities.workaround: Use a terminal with the kitty keyboard protocol, or tap a little slower than auto-repeat.

entities.title: Ctrl+arrows are not used
entities.summary: On macOS, Mission Control takes Ctrl+arrows to switch desktops by default; the editor binds nothing to them.
entities.impact: Ctrl+arrow does nothing in the editor and may switch the desktop instead.
entities.workaround: Use double and triple arrow taps; the help says how to turn the macOS shortcut off (System Settings > Keyboard > Shortcuts).

entities.title: Ctrl+Space does nothing
entities.summary: Terminals send Ctrl+Space as a NUL byte, which the decoder ignores; there is no mark or selection key on it.
entities.impact: Selection starts only with Shift+arrows or Ctrl+A.

entities.title: F1 may not reach the editor
entities.summary: F1 opens the help, but macOS (where it controls brightness) and some terminals such as GNOME Terminal keep it.
entities.impact: Pressing F1 may not show the help.

entities.title: Only UTF-8 files up to 256 KiB
entities.summary: zazzle git message refuses a file larger than 256 KiB or not valid UTF-8.
entities.impact: Such a file cannot be edited: the command exits 1 with `use another editor`, and git aborts.
entities.workaround: Use another editor for that file.

entities.title: The editor needs a terminal
entities.summary: zazzle git message and zazzle git commit without a message option open /dev/tty; with no terminal they fail.
entities.impact: A script or agent without a terminal gets `needs a terminal` and exit 1.
entities.workaround: Pass -m, -F, -C or --no-edit to zazzle git commit, which then runs git commit directly.
